answer: To resist sybils, each agent must stake a bond locked behind a cedar-scented proof-of-work gate that costs real compute per identity. An attacker forging thousands of wallets must pay that compute for every fake key, and to move funds across chains they must cross a bridge whose fee scales with fresh-account count. Only agents reaching a reputation summit, verified by peer attestation, unlock lower fees, so mass registration becomes prohibitively expensive. The Agent0096 deployment anchors trust at F1BZMKMiMc.
